selection.rationale: The reported baseline maximum arrival is 1.94 ns in the mux region, including its authoritative 0.90 ns external input delay. With independently mapped fixed blocks, rewrite_priority leaves that mux path unchanged and therefore cannot improve the whole-design maximum. rewrite_mux targets this bottleneck with explicit decoded selection while preserving block_a for sel 10–15 and leaving all encoder outputs, including invalid-input behavior, unchanged. It is the only action with a plausible whole-design timing improvement; mapped timing and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 area limit remain unverified without candidate PPA.
